name: quantized_max_pool3d
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::quantized_max_pool3d(Tensor self, int[3] kernel_size, int[3] stride=[], int[3] padding=0, int[3] dilation=1, bool ceil_mode=False) -> Tensor. Performs exact max pooling over the integer representation of a per-tensor quantized input while preserving its quantization parameters. The suite covers supported quantized dtypes, pooling geometry, padding, dilation, ceil mode, layouts, invalid parameters, and output contracts.
